purpose: Question-only adult ambiguity and answerability screen. These are fictional test cases, not customer facts.
reviewBoundary: Judge whether each immediate question contains one understandable, answerable ask and whether its answer contract makes uncertainty safe. Do not judge the hidden oracle or infer product efficacy.

questions.decisionFocus: Whether to run a limited AI scheduling pilot or commit the whole care network before the safety and service gates are known.
questions.question: Which failure would make you stop the pilot even if it saves staff time?

answerContract.evidenceRequestIfUnknown: Name the incident, complaint or service standard that should define the stopping rule.

questions.decisionFocus: Whether the service gain survives the two unsafe schedules and the continuity standard families value.
questions.question: Out of 1,000 scheduled journeys, how many unsafe ones would stop the rollout?

answerContract.evidenceRequestIfUnknown: Review the safety baseline and total journey volume before setting the limit.

questions.decisionFocus: Whether the pilot can restore complex-care continuity without Elena becoming the permanent exception handler.
questions.question: Out of every 100 vulnerable clients, how many must keep the same carer before you expand?

answerContract.unit: vulnerable clients keeping the same carer
answerContract.evidenceRequestIfUnknown: Review current continuity and the service promise made to vulnerable clients.

questions.decisionFocus: Whether to move half the firm from bespoke projects into a monthly product before knowing what clients actually renew for.
questions.question: When clients hired you again, what did they mention most: speed, access between projects, or live challenge?

answerContract.evidenceRequestIfUnknown: Ask repeat clients which part of the work made them hire Lumen again.

questions.decisionFocus: Whether a repeatable decision-room product can preserve the senior challenge clients renew for without rebuilding a dashboard nobody needs.
questions.question: Have any clients agreed to buy the monthly product without a senior researcher in the room?

answerContract.evidenceRequestIfUnknown: Find a signed commitment or run a purchase test without a senior researcher present.

questions.decisionFocus: Whether to scale the paid decision-room format after the dashboard route failed, and what proof should unlock moving half the team.
questions.question: How many clients must pay for the new service again before you move half the team?

answerContract.unit: clients who pay for the new service again
answerContract.comparator: the minimum required before moving half the team
answerContract.evidenceRequestIfUnknown: Model the revenue and delivery capacity at different repeat-purchase counts.

questions.decisionFocus: Whether to redesign planning roles and buy the system now, or first test whether data and measures are creating the apparent resistance.
questions.question: If the same planners hit the target with accurate information and fair targets, would you still change their roles?

answerContract.evidenceRequestIfUnknown: Use one same-team test before deciding whether the roles must change.

questions.decisionFocus: Whether one plant can prove the new operating conditions with the same planners before Forgepoint commits all six plants.
questions.question: Will one plant have to hit the delivery target with the same planners before you fund all six?

answerContract.evidenceRequestIfUnknown: Name one plant, one delivery target, one time window and the funding decision it controls.

questions.decisionFocus: Which planning work should move to AI after one plant showed the same people can improve when data and measures change.
questions.question: Who makes the final call when an AI plan could make a customer late: a planner or the system?

options: It depends on a named condition
answerContract.evidenceRequestIfUnknown: Review late-order cases and identify where customer accountability cannot be delegated.

questions.decisionFocus: Whether to fund a precision fan-intelligence system before the campaign has a named audience movement and human creative boundary.
questions.question: Which group of fans must buy more tickets for you to move the GBP 18 million?

answerContract.evidenceRequestIfUnknown: Use ticket-buyer and audience evidence to define the group before choosing a route.

questions.decisionFocus: Which exposure route can invite franchise-new viewers in without exhausting core fans or confusing the story.
questions.question: What should new viewers see first: one character's story or several fan theories?

answerContract.evidenceRequestIfUnknown: Run both routes with comparable groups of franchise-new viewers.

questions.decisionFocus: What held-out proof should unlock the next major shift after three releases showed audience and sequence matter more than content volume.
questions.question: Out of 100 new viewers, how many more must want a ticket than after today's campaign before you move GBP 18 million?

answerContract.unit: additional new viewers who say they want a ticket
answerContract.evidenceRequestIfUnknown: Set the current campaign baseline and the minimum lift needed to justify the allocation.
